checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=39 breakdowns=1 bursts_in_base=1 giveback=1.03 tightness=0.88 base_volume_vs_leg=0.91 base_volume_vs_avg=0.94
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 39 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; the base gave back 1.03 of the leg

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close -8.0% vs its 20-SMA, -16.2% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 0 of 2 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The base is 39 sessions long — nearly double Bonde's 20-session maximum — and gave back 1.03 of the prior leg, meaning the entire leg gain was erased inside the consolidation; the chart confirms this as a visible declining base from ~$240 down to ~$170 with wide, overlapping red bars throughout the shaded region. Volume on the signal bar was below the prior session (0.97x) and only 1.14x the 50-session average against a required 1.5x catalyst-volume threshold for bases over 21 sessions, so VOL also fails. Two independent measured failures (C and VOL) together with a visibly declining, loose base make this a skip.
claude.key_risk: The 'base' is actually a multi-month downtrend with heavy overhead supply from $200–$240 and a giveback of 1.03x the prior leg, leaving no structural floor for a momentum burst to build on.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the signal day's close of $178.47 or if the first 30 minutes show no buying interest, confirming the base's downtrend character.
